=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1729-1778 (also README.md:182, header comment at lines 1699-1700, inline comment at line 1773) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The README row at line 182 and the comments at lines 1699-1700 and 1773 say the forward-merge kill-switch drop happens "before any read", but `_mt_resolve_automation_login` (lines 1740-1743) runs its cached `GET user` read before the kill-switch check at lines 1774-1778.
  WHY: All three reviewers rated this NIT. It is only a documentation and comment error: the API-call count is off by one cached read per tick, and behaviour is otherwise correct. The reviewers disagree on one detail: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite says an extra label read also happens before the drop, while anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says labels come from the cached listing at line 1759. The agents.d fragment already has the accurate wording, "before the statuses read".
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1740-1777 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: If `_mt_resolve_automation_login` fails, `_mt_final_ci_merge_resume` returns (line 1742, `reason=login_unavailable`) before it reaches the `FORWARD_MERGE_FALLBACK_AUTO_MERGE` disabled branch. The `ai:final-ci-merge-pending` label then stays on, and `forward_merge_auto_merge_disabled` is never logged.
  WHY: All three reviewers rated this NIT, with confidence 4-5. During a GitHub API outage the switch-off drop is skipped. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 looked at this ordering and dropped it as a non-regression, because it predates this PR and applies to every head.
- README.md:165 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The `FINAL_CI_MERGE_RESUME_ENABLED` row still says forward-merge heads are skipped and that resume uses `--squash --match-head-commit`. The rewritten `FORWARD_MERGE_FALLBACK_AUTO_MERGE` row (line 182) describes the new `--merge` behaviour, so the README contradicts itself.
  WHY: Rated NIT. The scripts behave correctly, but an operator could think a stuck forward-merge PR needs a manual merge, which is the confusion behind #9891. Fixing it takes about 2 lines.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

Only the `FORWARD_MERGE_FALLBACK_AUTO_MERGE` row at line 182 describes the new merge-commit behaviour, even though the diff removes forward-merge heads from not_eligible (scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1744-1745). google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite gave the site as the README `FORWARD_MERGE_FALLBACK_AUTO_MERGE` row and said the README describes forward-merge fallback PRs as needing manual merge-commit handling. Severities: MAJOR (minimax_minimax-m3), NIT (the others).
- requirement: "Keep the FINAL_CI_MERGE_RESUME log contract current when adding its new reason and method fields."
  expected_change_site: agents.d/9919-forward-merge-final-ci-resume.md under `## Stable log prefixes (contractual)` (existing registry line at agents.d/merge-lease-final-ci-resume.md:10)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

The `FINAL_CI_MERGE_RESUME` schema (`pr= head= outcome=auto_merge_enabled|waiting|deferred|dropped|failed reason=`) is not updated to include reason `forward_merge_auto_merge_disabled` (scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1776) or `method=squash|merge` (scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1817, 1830). Severities: MAJOR (minimax_minimax-m3), NIT (the others). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked this and dropped it: the registry line does not list reason tokens, and the fragment documents `method=` in its Workflow architecture section.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- README.md:Line 165, the `FINAL_CI_MERGE_RESUME_ENABLED` row | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The row says "Forks, drafts, integration and forward-merge heads are skipped" and that resume squashes. But lines 1744-1749 of scripts/review_merge_train.sh no longer mark `^auto/forward-merge-stable-` heads as not_eligible, and lines 1752-1755 and 1816 merge those heads with `--merge`. Line 182 was rewritten and line 165 was not, so the README contradicts itself.
  WHY: The scripts behave correctly, but operators could think a manual merge is needed (the #9891 confusion). Fix in about 2 lines.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh (also README.md line 182):header comment at lines 1699-1700, inline comment at line 1773, README row at line 182 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_mt_resolve_automation_login` (lines 1740-1743) runs its cached `GET user` read before the kill-switch check at lines 1774-1778, so the drop does not happen "before any read". The pass-1 claim of an extra per-PR label read is wrong, because labels come from the cached listing (line 1759).
  WHY: Behaviour is correct. Only the API-call count is off, by one cached read per tick.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. Pass-1 items checked and dropped: the `_pr_label_list_for_pr` read claim, the login-failure ordering (not a regression), and the `FINAL_CI_MERGE_RESUME` registry schema gap.
